The request is for adding TSV (tab-delimited) export support to reports, alongside CSV and XLSX. This would address the manual conversion issue when transaction descriptions contain commas. The change would primarily involve extending the `renderExport` function and updating `SUPPORTED_FORMATS` in `src/exportUtils`.

input.title: Add TSV export support to the reports endpoint
input.body:
File: src/api/reports.ts

The reports export currently supports CSV and XLSX formats. To align with the warehouse loader's requirement for tab-delimited files, add TSV support to the `renderExport` function and update the `SUPPORTED_FORMATS` enum. This will allow users to export reports directly as TSV, avoiding manual conversion errors caused by commas in transaction descriptions.
